items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Charlie McCurdy's boys, boys, yeah, he from Algeys too.

ctx.x: The fellow worked with him on piccolo too, Bab Frank, I think.
Yeah. Charlie McCurdy's boys, yeah. Charlie McCurdy's boys, boys, yeah, he from Algeys too. I'm not sure, I don't remember. I know they used to have some McCurdy's from Algeys students to play music.
Who all was over there in Algeys when you were a youngster? The musicians?
